name: mean per game and rate per game are different numbers on the same measure (executed-result parity)
description: An earlier draft of this contract made rate and mean mutually exclusive on the premise that they coincide. They do not, and this is the fixture that says so with a number rather than an argument: rate divides by games PLAYED (player_gamelogs where is_active), mean divides by the periods CARRYING measure rows. Seed four active games and receptions in only three of them -- 120, 90, 150 and a fourth game with a play but no completion. Mean per game is 360/3 = 120; rate per game is 360/4 = 90. A mean implemented as a rate answers 90 for both columns, and a rate implemented as a mean answers 120 for both. Measured on production the two disagree for 366 of 482 players on 2023 REG receiving yards.
